The '''Defender 01-X''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that saw use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Similar to the [[Defender 03-Z]] but lacking a shield, the Defender 01-X carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and a number of them were deployed to protect the [[satellite control tower]] on the [[Markaran Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Defender 01-Xs appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Markaran Plains as part of the mission "Calling All Droids" in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
